jobs.title: Sales Assistant to Director(总监销售助理)
jobs.salary: $60,000/年(时薪结算,可享加班,另有半年度酌情奖金)
jobs.summary: 协助画廊总监开展销售:准备报价与客户文件、管理二级市场寄售、协调库存与展览、办理保险估价、组织客户活动及日常行政排期。要求艺术史/艺术管理/工商管理本科,2-3年画廊助理或行政支持经验,优秀写作能力与当代艺术专业知识。

Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Art History, Arts Management, or Business Administration; 2-3 years of gallery assistant or administrative support experience; excellent writing skills and knowledge of contemporary art.

jobs.title: Sales Assistant to Senior Director(资深总监销售助理)
jobs.summary: 协助资深总监:管理艺术家与客户沟通、跟踪国内外展览与借展、处理报价发票与保险估价、经办二级市场寄售、安排日程差旅、跨部门协调库存与展务。要求艺术史/艺术管理本科+2年相关经验,出色写作能力及当代艺术知识。
jobs.title_zh: Sales Assistant to Senior Director(资深总监销售助理)

jobs.summary_en: Assist the senior director: manage communication with artists and clients, track domestic and international exhibitions and loans, handle quotes, invoices, and insurance appraisals, manage secondary market consignments, schedule appointments and travel, and coordinate inventory and exhibition services across departments. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Art History or Arts Management plus 2 years of relevant experience; excellent writing skills and knowledge of contemporary art.

jobs.title: DZ19 Facilities Manager(设施经理/运营)
jobs.summary: 负责画廊W19街空间的日常维护与运营:管理HVAC及保洁供应商、协调施工项目、制定预防性维护计划、支持活动后勤、确保建筑规范合规、管理运营预算并带领一名设施助理。要求本科+5年以上设施/楼宇管理经验,熟悉水电暖通消防系统。
jobs.title_zh: DZ19 Facilities Manager(设施经理/运营)

jobs.summary_en: Responsible for the daily maintenance and operations of the gallery's W19 Street space: manage HVAC and cleaning vendors, coordinate construction projects, develop preventive maintenance plans, support event logistics, ensure building code compliance, manage the operations budget, and lead a facilities assistant. Requirements: Bachelor's degree plus 5+ years of facilities/building management experience; familiarity with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire protection systems.

jobs.title: Executive Director(执行馆长)
jobs.org: The Franklin G. Burroughs-Simeon B. Chapin Art Museum(默特尔比奇艺术博物馆)
jobs.summary: 为博物馆提供战略与实务领导,统筹艺术方向、展览、藏品、社区参与、机构发展、筹款、运营、设施与公众参与。要求至少5年艺术/文化机构领导经验,艺术、艺术史、博物馆学、商科或财务本科(硕士优先),具备管理、财务、筹款与拨款申请能力。
jobs.summary_zh: 为博物馆提供战略与实务领导,统筹艺术方向、展览、藏品、社区参与、机构发展、筹款、运营、设施与公众参与。要求至少5年艺术/文化机构领导经验,艺术、艺术史、博物馆学、商科或财务本科(硕士优先),具备管理、财务、筹款与拨款申请能力。
jobs.summary_en: Provide strategic and operational leadership for the museum, overseeing artistic direction, exhibitions, collections, community engagement, institutional development, fundraising, operations, facilities, and public participation. Requirements: at least 5 years of leadership experience in an arts/cultural institution; Bachelor's degree in Art, Art History, Museum Studies, Business, or Finance (Master's preferred); skills in management, finance, fundraising, and grant writing.

jobs.org: Swarthmore College, List Gallery(斯沃斯莫尔学院)
jobs.summary: 负责List画廊策展与运营:研究新兴及知名艺术家、每年策划四场大展、管理预算与合同、撰写拨款申请、监督15-20名学生员工及实习项目、负责设施与安全。要求硕士(MFA或同等博士)+5年以上博物馆级策展经验,熟悉艺术品处理、仓储、运输与保险。
jobs.title_zh: Director & Curator, List Gallery(画廊总监兼策展人)

jobs.summary_en: Responsible for curatorial and operational leadership of List Gallery: research emerging and established artists, curate four major exhibitions per year, manage budgets and contracts, write grant proposals, supervise 15-20 student staff and internship program, oversee facilities and security. Requirements: Master's degree (MFA or equivalent doctorate) plus 5+ years of museum-level curatorial experience; familiarity with art handling, storage, shipping, and insurance.

jobs.title: Museum Educator(博物馆教育员)
jobs.org: Miami Children's Museum(迈阿密儿童博物馆)
jobs.summary: 面向0-5岁儿童在展厅开展导览与互动教育活动,并在馆外及线上承担外展教学项目,负责维护展品材料、保持展区整洁并保障参观者安全。要求有与儿童相处经验、能掌控大群体、沟通力强,双语及教学经验者优先。
jobs.summary_zh: 面向0-5岁儿童在展厅开展导览与互动教育活动,并在馆外及线上承担外展教学项目,负责维护展品材料、保持展区整洁并保障参观者安全。要求有与儿童相处经验、能掌控大群体、沟通力强,双语及教学经验者优先。
jobs.summary_en: Conduct guided tours and interactive educational activities for children aged 0-5 in the galleries, and lead outreach teaching programs off-site and online; responsible for maintaining exhibit materials, keeping the gallery clean, and ensuring visitor safety. Requirements: experience working with children, ability to manage large groups, strong communication skills; bilingual and teaching experience preferred.

jobs.title: Art Educator(艺术教育员)
jobs.org: The Art Museum of Eastern Idaho(爱达荷东部艺术博物馆)
jobs.summary: 为各年龄段开设美术课程与工作坊、带领展厅导览,依据展览与馆藏设计教案,布置及清理教室,运用视觉思维策略(VTS)开展教学并担任观众服务。要求高中以上学历(教育或艺术学士优先),具1-3年教学经验、协作能力强。
jobs.summary_zh: 为各年龄段开设美术课程与工作坊、带领展厅导览，依据展览与馆藏设计教案，布置及清理教室，运用视觉思维策略（VTS）开展教学并担任观众服务。要求高中以上学历（教育或艺术学士优先），具1-3年教学经验、协作能力强。
jobs.summary_en: Conduct art classes and workshops for all ages, lead gallery tours, design lesson plans based on exhibitions and collections, set up and clean classrooms, teach using Visual Thinking Strategies (VTS), and serve as audience service. Requires high school diploma or above (Bachelor's in Education or Art preferred), 1-3 years teaching experience, and strong collaboration skills.

jobs.title_zh: Restorative Practices Youth Lead Teaching Artist（青少年主教学艺术家）

Requires relevant Bachelor's plus 4 years experience, or Master's plus 2 years experience, and evidence of effective teaching. Start Fall 2026 or Spring 2027.
